text:
Asha (PM): FYI @here large customer (FinNet) pushed urgent request: dedicated cluster auth failures on long-running streams. They want timeline + comms.
Priya (Sales AE): they hit 500s when sequences >4096 on our dedicated pool. Impacting production customers. Asking for hotfix, not next minor.
Sam (Support): logs show token mismatch in the auth handshake when reconnecting after idle. Repro on staging dedicated. Error: `kv_auth: invalid_session_token`
Diego (Eng Lead): can you paste the minimal repro?
Sam (Support): pasted gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx - simple reconnect loop + streaming payload
Diego (Eng Lead): ok looking. This looks like session token expiry handling in the dedicated proxy. Likely a race: token refresh + reconnect. Low risk to model runtime but touches connection manager.
Asha (PM): Qs: 1) hotfix feasible in 48-72h? 2) canary plan? 3) comms message for customer (and broader customers on Dedicated)?
Diego (Eng Lead): 1) engineering estimate: 2 devs, ~1.5 dev-days to implement fix + unit tests. 1 more day for integration QA. So yes within 72h if we prioritize.
Liam (Release Manager): 2) we can canary on a single Dedicated pool in us-west-2 with health checks for 30m, traffic shift 5->25->50%. Need rollback flag.
Nina (SRE): we need a fallback policy: if latency p50 increases >200ms or error rate >0.5% abort. Automate with canary job.
Priya (Sales AE): FinNet specifically needs <0.1% error rate SLA. They'll accept scheduled 1hr maintenance window tonight if we can guarantee rollback.
Asha (PM): Scope negotiation: do we include telemetry to detect similar token expiry elsewhere? That adds ~0.5 day but gives visibility. Decision?
Diego (Eng Lead): add a lightweight metric: `session_reauth_failures` + metadata (pool, model). 0.5 day to instrument + dashboards. Worth it.
Sam (Support): also recommend adding a config knob for token-refresh window to tune for customers with long seqs. Small change.
Liam (Release Manager): deployment plan sketch: patch branch -> internal canary -> staged cluster -> dedicated us-west canary -> wider rollout. Estimated total 6-8 hours from merge to full rollout if canaries pass.
Asha (PM): Comms draft for Priya: short note to FinNet: "We identified a session refresh race impacting long-lived streams. We have a targeted patch and plan a staged rollout tonight with a one-hour maintenance window. We'll monitor and share rollback plan." Approve?
Priya (Sales AE): yep approve. Add contact: priya@redwood.ai and oncall.
Nina (SRE): oncall rota: nina -> diego -> infra-oncall. I'll create an incident channel and a PagerDuty escalation for the rollout window.
CanaryBot: Canary job created: canary-1719876543-usw2, watch metrics: error_rate,p50_latency.
Diego (Eng Lead): dev PR incoming in ~3 hours. Tagging @Liam for release readiness and @Nina for monitoring.
Liam (Release Manager): I'll allocate the us-west pool and prepare rollback runbook (steps + feature-flag revert).
Asha (PM): Decision: hotfix tonight. Must include metric instrumentation and the token-refresh config knob. Priya will send customer comms. Diego + Nina + Liam own rollout. Sam will validate staging repro post-PR.
Priya (Sales AE): sending comms now to FinNet (cc: Asha, Diego).
Sam (Support): once PR lands I'll rerun the repro and post results here.
Diego (Eng Lead): quick snippet of the change below
```
diff --git a/proxy/session.go b/proxy/session.go
@@ -123,6 +123,12 @@ func refreshToken(...) error {
-    // old behavior
+    // avoid race: acquire refresh lock, validate token window
+    mu.Lock()
+    defer mu.Unlock()
+    if token.ExpiresIn < refreshThreshold {
+        // trigger synchronous refresh
+    }
     ...
 }
```
Sam (Support): test run (staging) after PR: reconnect loop passed 1000 iterations, no `invalid_session_token` seen.
Nina (SRE): canary started. Initial metrics look clean (error_rate 0.02%, p50 +20ms). Holding at 5% traffic.
Liam (Release Manager): advancing to 25% per plan. No regressions.
Priya (Sales AE): FinNet on the line, providing thumbs up for the maintenance window.
Nina (SRE): advancing to 50% now. All checks green.
CanaryBot: Canary job healthy at 50% for 20m.
Diego (Eng Lead): merging patch to main. Please note the token-refresh knob added to config for Dedicated pools: `session_refresh_margin_ms`.
Liam (Release Manager): rollout complete to all Dedicated pools. Post-deploy verification scheduled for 2h.
Asha (PM): closing loop: 1) hotfix shipped, 2) customer notified, 3) dashboards updated, 4) postmortem + RCA to follow (cover why race existed and how tests missed it). Thanks team. :tada:
Sam (Support): FinNet confirmed resolved. No further errors.
Priya (Sales AE): closing ticket with FinNet, offering follow-up health-check in 48h.
Diego (Eng Lead): I'll drop a short note in the postmortems channel with links to PR and canary logs.
Nina (SRE): created incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1719876543
Asha (PM): assigning follow-ups: Diego -> tests + durable session tests; Nina -> long-run canary metrics; Sam -> update KB; Priya -> close customer comms. We'll review in next weekly triage.
Priya (Sales AE): thanks everyone.
Diego (Eng Lead): good job team.
